name: basehalf-ai-video
description: Thin video-domain pack for BaseHalf's main canvas: recipes, a starter template, Sequence projection, and bounded structural cleanup.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Video workflow recipes may create user-approved local planning artifacts.

basehalfAgentCapabilities.label: Video Workflow Documents
basehalfAgentCapabilities.description: Describe shots and arrange exact local clip results without adding another canvas, editor, or renderer.

documents.schemaSummary: A shot.json root object with version 1, kind pointa.basehalf-ai-video.shot, a stable id, a title, and clipNodePath ending in .bhnode. clipNodePath is relative to the directory containing that shot.json file.

A video-sequence.json root object with version 1, kind pointa.basehalf-ai-video.sequence, and ordered items. Every item requires a unique id, title, stable nodeId, videoNodePath ending in .bhnode relative to the directory containing video-sequence.json, and an exact versionId.

operations.description: Validate every exact clip pin and report explicit Current updates without modifying the Sequence.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file in the open local workspace.

returns.description: Validation status, update count, and per-item pin state.

operations.description: Append one verified Video Current as an exact pinned Sequence item.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: videoNode
parameters.description: URI of a saved Video result node under the workflow root containing video-sequence.json.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Unique stable id for the new Sequence item.

returns.description: The add operation, saved item, saved Sequence document, and fresh inspection.

operations.description: Move one pinned clip by one position in basic playback order.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item to move.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Move the item one position earlier or later.

returns.description: The saved Sequence document after the move.

operations.description: Explicitly replace one exact pin with that Video node's verified Current version.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item to update.

returns.description: Fresh Sequence inspection after the explicit pin update.

operations.description: Remove one playback-order reference while preserving its Video node and local results.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item to remove.

returns.description: The remove operation, removed item, saved Sequence document, and fresh inspection.

operations.description: Explicitly repair one moved clip path after a bounded stable-identity scan verifies one unique node and the exact pinned result.

parameters.name: sequence
parameters.description: URI of the existing Sequence JSON file.

parameters.name: itemId
parameters.description: Stable id of the Sequence item whose missing path should be repaired.

returns.description: Fresh Sequence inspection after the explicit path repair.
